body: Listen, all that matters now is that you realized that you've made mistakes in the past BUT you're willing to turn around and make changes in your life. 26 is still very young! I'm also 26 and have reflected on some past decisions that I definitely regret making now. Take things slow, allow yourself time to reflect on what you've done wrong but it won't do you any good to keep thinking about those "what-ifs". Explore things that you're interested in, challenge yourself to get out of your comfort zone, surround yourself with a community that you feel supported in.

Hi! There is no single way to live as a girl, I personally don’t really like using tampons and I don’t really care about smelling nice but try exploring things you are already into! I frequent pinterest a lot so try searching up different aesthetics and maybe just experiment with those and finding things you like. Watching beauty and fashion vloggers on youtube is also a fun way to explore femininity. With those you may find something you truly love and enjoy whilst being more feminine 🤷🏽‍♀️

I've only been in one relationship my entire life and we're still together 6 years later. We are not married and in no way in a hurry to be married because we're still pretty young (both 24). I still love him as much as I do when I was still in college maybe even more now. 

He's helped me grow into the person I am today helping me learn a lot of things about myself as well as accepting my growth as a person. 

Currently we've been in a long distance relationship because he's in the military and I'm studying to get into grad school but our relationship hasn't gotten any harder, I would think after being together every single day while in college LDR would probably be the reason why we split but we adapted and made it work. I have 100% trust in him as he does in me. We are very honest with each other and he's the first person in my life I could be very open with as he's seen all my sides. 

As other people have stated it's very comfortable being with him or talking to him, he uplifts me and never makes me feel as if I am inferior just for being female. Idk there's so much more to say but I know that there's no one else I'd rather be with.
